messages:
IncidentBot: P1 alert — unusual metering delta for tenant Zephyr Health (tenant_id=zph-3421) on dedicated pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3. Metering delta +652,340 tokens in 13m. Alert: https://console.redwood/alerts/1762345123

Maria (oncall-sre): acked. pulling logs + meter stream now. tagging @Sam (billing-lead).

Maria (oncall-sre): quick check — is this a billing ingestion issue or genuine traffic spike?

Sam (billing-lead): on it. can you confirm runtime traffic for that tenant? any large streaming sessions?

Jordan (platform-ops): I see a burst of long-lived streaming sessions from zph-3421 on node euw3-dedpool-07. CPU/mem are normal but token emission rate is high. looks like duplicate metering events streaming through the pipeline.

Lee (runtime): FYI we rolled a change to streaming fallback recently that added chunk-level and final-event metrics. If both are being counted as billable that's bad. I can flip a dedupe flag in metering agent.

Maria (oncall-sre): running steps: 1) pull billing_events, 2) cross-ref runtime request_ids, 3) check deploy history for metering agents.

Maria (oncall-sre): running SQL to sample event types now:

```sql
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM billing_events
WHERE tenant_id = 'zph-3421' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
GROUP BY event_type;
```

Maria (oncall-sre): query result: chunk_emit: 412k, final_emit: 412k, session_open: 1. identical counts for chunk and final.

Sam (billing-lead): that looks like double-count. if both types were billed we'd see ~2x usage. did metering agent v2.8 go live?

Jordan (platform-ops): mether-agent v2.8 rolled in eu-west yesterday. it introduced emission of both 'chunk_emit' and 'final_emit' for streaming attribution. the intent was to mark chunk as non-billable, but the flag wasn't set.

Lee (runtime): canary the dedupe flag on node euw3-dedpool-07: export METERING_DEDUPE=true for the agent. small canary first then pool roll?

Maria (oncall-sre): yes canary on node-07 first. also pause any outgoing billing notifications to the tenant until we have a reconciliation. @Ava hold customer comms.

deploy-bot: starting canary rollout of mether-agent v2.8 with METERING_DEDUPE=true on euw3-dedpool-07. https://deploys.redwood/canary/1762345201

Ava (support): acknowledged. holding outbound messages; will prepare a transparency note but won't send yet.

Sam (billing-lead): running reconciliation to compute true billable tokens. simplified plan: align session_id tokens between chunk and final and take the minimum per session.

Sam (billing-lead): reconciliation query (running):

```sql
WITH stream_tokens AS (
  SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_chunk
  FROM billing_events
  WHERE tenant_id='zph-3421' AND event_type='chunk_emit' AND ts > now()-INTERVAL '1 hour'
  GROUP BY session_id
), final_tokens AS (
  SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_final
  FROM billing_events
  WHERE tenant_id='zph-3421' AND event_type='final_emit' AND ts > now()-INTERVAL '1 hour'
  GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT SUM(LEAST(tokens_chunk, COALESCE(tokens_final,0))) as presumed_billable
FROM stream_tokens st
LEFT JOIN final_tokens ft USING (session_id);
```

Jordan (platform-ops): canary succeeded on node-07; new events show only 'final_emit' for that tenant. looks like dedupe flag fixed new traffic.

deploy-bot: canary passed. proceeding with controlled roll across eu-west-1-dedicated-3 at 2 nodes/min.

Lee (runtime): rolling METERING_DEDUPE=true across rest of pool. monitoring.

Maria (oncall-sre): monitoring billing_event stream for duplicate ratio. if it drops to baseline, bug confirmed and we can reconcile retroactively.

Maria (oncall-sre): post-roll update: new events only 'final_emit'. token-rate for Zephyr back to normal. historical duped events remain and need crediting.

Sam (billing-lead): raw reported delta: +652,340 tokens. reconciliation suggests actual billable ~326,170 tokens. plan to issue credit for ~326,170 tokens. calculating $ amount next.

Ava (support): draft to customer (holding until numbers verified):

"Hi team — we detected an internal metering issue in your dedicated pool on eu-west-1 that caused an over-count of usage. We've applied a fix and are reconciling. We will issue a credit for any overbilled usage and follow up with details within 24 hours. Apologies for the inconvenience. Reply here for urgent questions"

Maria (oncall-sre): Sam, please add billing correction ticket to incident timeline and include reconciliation dump. we'll attach to postmortem.

Sam (billing-lead): created billing correction ticket ZH-CR-1024. added estimated credit + reconciliation artifacts. will compute exact dollar credit per plan rates and submit to finance.

Jordan (platform-ops): root cause summary: mether-agent v2.8 emitted both chunk and final event types while the 'non-billable' marker was not set. mitigation: enable dedupe flag, add unit tests to prevent regression, and add alert on duplicate event type ratio > 1.5x.

Lee (runtime): mitigation complete; canary and roll healthy. opening PR to add gating and tests before next metering release.

Maria (oncall-sre): next steps / owners: Sam finalize credit + update ticket (ETA 2h); Ava send customer note once credit confirmed (ETA 3h); Lee PR for gating/tests (ETA EOD); Jordan add duplicate-event alert + daily audit job (ETA 24h); Maria include timeline in postmortem and link runbook (ETA EOD).

Ava (support): noted. will queue message for send after Sam confirms numbers.

Sam (billing-lead): numbers confirmed: credit = 326,170 tokens -> $1,307 (rounded per billing plan). ticket ZH-CR-1024 updated and queued for finance approval.

Ava (support): sent customer message including credit amount and summary to Zephyr account owners and opened follow-up channel.

Maria (oncall-sre): marking incident mitigated. timeline recorded; mitigation rolled; credit prepared; postmortem draft created.

IncidentBot: Incident 1762345123 — mitigated. Postmortem draft: https://pm.redwood/incidents/1762345123

Maria (oncall-sre): small follow-up: recommend adding a release gating step requiring +1 from billing on metering changes affecting dedicated pools.

Sam (billing-lead): agreed. I'll add release gating to metering release playbook.

Jordan (platform-ops): adding alert for duplicate event type ratio and a daily audit across dedicated pools.

Ava (support): finance will issue formal credit memo on request; customer requested statement of correction for their accounting.

Maria (oncall-sre): handing off to postmortem owner Lee. oncall clear.

Maria (oncall-sre): handoff complete. last_message_ts: 1762345778
